subject.title: fix: preserve selected GitHub skills across resync

question: Should persisted selected GitHub skill paths become the GitHub source sync contract now, with legacy all-skills sources preserved and selected-path dry-runs required before merge?
rationale: This changes stored source configuration and can hide previously synced skills when a source is scoped, so maintainer intent is needed on the compatibility contract and proof bar before landing.

options.title: Refresh And Prove Selected Sources
options.body: Resolve the dirty merge state, drop the merged warm-up overlap, make dry-runs selected-path-aware, and validate selected plus legacy source sync before merge.

options.title: Accept Selection Contract As-Is
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the stored selection behavior, but should explicitly own the dry-run mismatch and upgrade proof gap.

options.title: Pause Selection Policy
options.body: Keep the draft paused if maintainers are not ready to make selected paths part of persisted GitHub source configuration.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Prove Selected Sources
recommendation.body: Resolve the dirty merge state, drop the merged warm-up overlap, make dry-runs selected-path-aware, and validate selected plus legacy source sync before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and have the strongest history on GitHub-backed skill source sync, which is the compatibility boundary being changed.
